scope: Non-exhaustive, public-page read-only competitive check of agent-native RFQ creation, opt-in supplier workflows, agent-to-agent B2B exchange and advertised fees. Complements 2026-10-14 RFQ competitor file; not a market census.

competitors.fee_terms: Terms dated 2026-09-15 say Deal Room default per-role fee is 0%; nonzero fees may be disclosed for a specific deal and require acceptance. Not a proven effective take rate.
competitors.supplier_count_quality: Agents page/terms claim 17,668+ verified suppliers, while home page claims 11,949; neither figure independently audited and the inconsistent site figures must not be used as verified concentration, usage, or revenue.
competitors.data_rights: Terms prohibit scraping/harvesting without written permission and systematic trade-data export for competing products.

advertised_capabilities: RFQ email intake and attachment extraction
supplier selection from user's own lists
competitors.published_free_limit: 30 manually sent RFQs/month, up to 20 suppliers per RFQ; AI agent is a one-time 7-day trial with 70 requests on Free/Individual, not permanently free agent automation.
competitors.published_paid_agent_quotas: Team 100, Professional 400 AI agent requests/month; additional Team+ packs 50 for USD 49, 150 for USD 129, 300 for USD 219.

advertised_capabilities: opt-in supplier invitation through buyer referral
AI supplier sourcing and RFQ email workflow
competitors.published_price_claims: Free to start; no commission on distributor deals; supplier joining by buyer referral is advertised as free. Full enterprise economics and actual realized fees are unknown.
competitors.published_activity_caveat: Homepage's dynamic counters/quotes are vendor claims and not independently audited transactions, RFQs, buyers or revenue.

comparison_to_agentmine: Generic opt-in RFQ, agent RFQ drafting, supplier discovery and MCP/A2A B2B matching are already advertised; differentiated outcome or verified niche buyer pain is required. Do not assume the competitors' live functionality, verified buyers, supplier counts, or monetization from marketing pages.
strategic_gate: Keep Phase 0. Do not launch generic RFQ marketplace or transaction-fee exchange. Continue 3 lawful direct-vs-route task outcomes OR consented paired supplier decisions with independently checked correctness/minutes/variable cost and >=3 explicit price/pilot responses. Test source-conflict exception resolution only if incumbents demonstrably fail a real task.
acquisition: Read only public individual vendor pages and terms; no account, scraping, bulk extraction, private data, payments or deployment.
